title: Shifting security left without stalling delivery

videos.script: Everybody agrees that security should shift left. Fewer people agree on what that means. {{line}} Left is a place on a drawing. It is earlier in the life of a change, while the person who wrote it still remembers why. The argument for it usually comes with a famous number. {{number}} A defect costs a hundred times more to fix after release. Nobody has found the study behind that number, and this lesson says so. There are better reasons, and you can check them yourself. {{budgets}} Every place a check can run has a time budget. The editor gets a second. A push gets about ten minutes. At night there is an hour to spare. {{measure}} You will measure linkbox's pipeline, stage by stage. You will run it on your laptop the way the server runs it. That turns up a defect in the pipeline itself, and you fix it. {{nightly}} Then the pipeline gets a second list, for the checks too slow for a push. A build from nothing, every night. Nothing is dropped. It just stops making people wait. {{done}}
